protocol: Load one prepared official task per world, prefer file-output tasks where available, and verify its original Compose hash against the pinned catalog.
Boot the immutable linux/amd64 world image with the original Harbor Compose services and native healthchecks.
From the real agent container, initialize MCP, list every tool page, call filesystem_server_list_files on /, and close the session.
Run the original native snapshot collector and inspect both archives inside the world container, recording SHA256, size, member count and member-name hash.
Tear down only the audit project and its volumes; remove only newly pulled world-image references.

audit_only_adjustment.scope: Temporary extra Compose layer for this no-model component audit. Prepared official task files and native grader code stay unchanged.
audit_only_adjustment.reason: Message-only tasks do not normally capture an initial snapshot. This diagnostic enables the existing native function so both snapshot paths are checked for every world.
audit_only_adjustment.first_world: The first world already had native initial capture enabled and passed before the temporary layer was added.

prior_attempts.reason: The first diagnostic assumed every task produced an initial snapshot. Native message-only tasks omit it; the audit later enabled the existing native capture flag.

The audit controller was cancelled to apply that diagnostic correction, then resumed with cleanup.

source_provenance.note: These are source observations, not a claim that every already-running Python process loaded the final file revisions. The runner narrowed transient Docker image inspection to selected fields during the audit; retained image identity fields were unchanged. Runtime capture/replay metadata was also extended in parallel. Native task files, pinned world images, MCP calls, snapshot functions and Compose build-isolation behavior were unchanged. The separate final-source Compose regression records the finalized shared hook behavior.

limits: This executes one environment task per world, not all 240 tasks.
No target agent, proposer, paid native judge or benchmark score is exercised.
The MCP call is a read-only root listing; individual action tools are not exhaustively exercised.
Snapshot archives were inspected inside each container and then cleaned up. Their digests and structural metadata remain; archive contents are not copied into the repository.
No unrelated pre-existing Docker image, container or volume was removed.
